item.title: Va kunghililwa va xulife po okunyateka odoolopa
item.description: Auleria Wakudumo Elelo lodoolopa yaMuthiya ola kunghilila ovakalimo opo va xulife po okukakeka odoolopanoimbodi. item.title: Hochland High ya pewa ekwatho lyoshimaliwa
item.description: Uuministeli welongo, uungomba, aanyasha, omaudhano, uunkulungu nosho wo oonkuluhedhi owa yambidhidha osikola Hochland High koWindhoek noshimaliwa N$60 000 okumana etungo lyokugongala. Uuministeli owa ti, owa yambidhidha ngaaka, sho wa pewa omukumo kosikola ya gongele oshimaliwa N$30 000 nelalakano lyokutunga etungo ndyoka. item.title: Ovanafikola kOnambutu omanyakwa moidano yopamifyuululwakalo
item.description: Ovanafikola kofikola Onambutu Combined noneudo ova nhukila mondabo okukala tava imbi nokudana oidano yopamifyuululwakalo molwaashi osha fimana okukaleka po omufyuululwakalo wOshiwambo.
